fire: By late summer the reservoir had been dwindling for months.
Support for the mayor dwindled after the scandal broke.
The explorers watched their food supplies dwindle day by day.
With membership dwindling, the club sold its hall.
As the candles burned low, the light dwindled to a faint glow.
Tiger numbers in the reserve are dwindling despite the patrols.
Her patience had dwindled to almost nothing by noon.
Each year the crowd at the fair dwindles a little more.
